title: Refuse Storage
previewText: All site plans must show an area designated for refuse storage. Any container used for refuse storage must be enclosed and screened either within a building or an accessory structure. If refuse storage is located in a container or accessory structure, it must be located at least 50 feet from any street line and screened on all sides by a six foot high masonry wall, with one side consisting of an opaque, lockable gate
